it would be helpful to document the shape of options here as config object params like this tend to grow in size and become hard to work with. from the code prior to this: 

```
 * @typedef {{
 *   numberOfChannels?: number
 *   sampleRate?: number
 *   loopMode?: LoopMode
 *   loopBegin?: number
 *   loopEnd?: number
 * }} SampleOptions
 ```

once options is typed, the inline annotations in the definition of stream below can be removed as well.
the obvious assignments (bools/numbers) can be inferred without type annotations, the annotations just add a decent amount of visual overhead/clutter.

imo it's easier & less error prone to do the scale math in the main driver message callback, instead of having to keep the scale parameter in the worklet synced up every time it changes.

(i did this in #123792 which will be superseded by this)

That would give you incorrect results, because it will use the pitchScle set when the callback is received, and not when the sample was processed.

So changing pitch would result in position slowly drifting away.

Syncing the scale as a parameter with the worklet makes sure it changes in the same audio frame when the buffersoruce changes (i.e. at the same AudioContext.currentTime), which ensures proper counting.
